help.title: Help & tips
help.intro: Everything useful to know - detection, notifications, controller, overlay, themes and troubleshooting.
help.noResults: No help topic matches your search.
quick: Add save/config folders in Settings > Folders, then enable the matching source in Settings > Sources.
The Watchdog runs in the background - it must be running for live notifications and playtime.
Everything (settings, caches, logs, custom themes) lives in %APPDATA%\Achievement Watcher Next.
Every settings section folds away under its own header - the chevron points down when open, sideways when closed. Your choices are remembered.
gameHealth: Open a game’s tools button (top right of its tile) to see whether it is Ready, Needs attention, or Not tracking.
The sentence under the state explains the cause in plain words; the checks below it show which part is at fault.
Repair buttons only appear when AW Next can genuinely fix that game - each one says what it will change and where the previous files are kept.
Technical details holds the exact paths, counts and emulator codes; copy it into a bug report.
troubleshoot: If a game is missing: add folders, rescan, then check the source toggle and blacklist.
If notifications don’t appear: check Windows Do not disturb / Focus Assist and run the app with the same rights as your games.
Advanced > Diagnostics opens logs and data folders; attach them when reporting an issue.
Logs are appended, so a crash survives the next launch. Each run starts with a session marker and a [diag] block (versions, paths, displays) - paste it into an issue.
sources: Steam profile mode lists installed or owned games, but unlocks still come from local save files.
GOG, Epic, Ubisoft Connect/LumaPlay and EA Desktop can be enabled separately in Sources.
Owned Steam games count as installed only when Steam’s registry confirms it.
steam: GBE / Goldberg saves are usually under %APPDATA%\GSE Saves or %APPDATA%\Goldberg SteamEmu Saves.
CODEX / RUNE saves often live under Public Documents\Steam\CODEX or Public Documents\Steam\RUNE.
TENOKE, UniverseLAN, SmartSteamEmu, ALI213 and Hoodlum are detected from their config/save folders.
The right-click emulator fix can add GBE Fork files, achievement schemas and DLC data.
Simple mode is fast; Advanced runs generate_emu_config for deeper Steam data and can take minutes.
emulators: RPCS3 trophies are read from dev_hdd0\home\...\trophy near the RPCS3 install.
shadPS4 trophies are read from its app data game_data/trophy folders; leftover data is not install proof.
Xenia progress is read from Xbox profile files such as .gpd.
controller: Enable Settings > Controller first, then Back + Start + LB opens the in-game overlay.
Navigation mode: D-pad/left stick move the focus, A confirms, B cancels, X searches, Y opens the options.
Hold LB + RB to move the overlay with the left stick and scroll with the right stick.
Works with Xbox, PlayStation (DualShock 4 / DualSense) and Switch Pro controllers.
overlay: Open it with the overlay hotkey (Ctrl+Shift+K by default) or Back + Start + LB on a controller.
Sort by one column at a time: Rarity, Date or Status (ascending / descending / none).
Press / to focus the search, Esc to clear it or close the options panel.
The gear panel changes accent, density, zoom, opacity and visible rows; 'Use app theme' follows the active theme.
Every achievement with a known rate shows its rarity: gray for common, gold/silver/bronze for rare.
shortcuts: Ctrl+Shift+K (default): toggle the in-game overlay - configurable in Settings > General.
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Arrows move the overlay; Ctrl+Alt+Shift+1-5 snap it to a preset position.
Ctrl+Alt+Shift+C toggles click-through; Ctrl+F focuses Settings search.
themes: Custom starts as Steam Blue; every layer (background, header, panels, cards, settings, text, borders, accent) is editable.
Layer images sit under a colored veil with a light frosted blur; effects are per layer.
Drop a CSS theme into <userData>\themes and it appears in the theme dropdown.
The custom preset builder can preview a design as a real popup before saving it, reopen a saved preset to change it, and delete the ones you do not keep.
Export the theme you use as one .awtheme file, or import one somebody sent you: it is previewed before it installs and then behaves like a built-in.
tips: Right-click a game tile to launch it, choose its executable, open folders and links, use emulator tools, or uninstall it when that menu is enabled.
Right-click a game and choose mute progress to stop progress popups without disabling unlocks.
The emulator fix (Simple fast / Advanced complete) installs GBE Fork, the achievement schema and DLC data.
Playtime is tracked while the game runs; progress and playtime notifications can be enabled in Notifications.
New achievements from a game update appear automatically within 3 days, or right away from Settings > Advanced > Recheck achievement lists.

dialogs.import-preset-duplicate-detail: Keep both installs the imported preset under a new name. Replace overwrites the installed one.
dialogs.import-preset-app-too-old: This preset needs AW Next {version} or newer.
dialogs.import-preset-format-too-new: This preset package was made by a newer version of AW Next.
dialogs.import-preset-invalid: This file is not a valid preset package.
dialogs.import-theme-duplicate-message: A theme named “{name}” is already installed.
dialogs.import-theme-duplicate-detail: Keep both installs the imported theme under a new name. Replace overwrites the installed one.
dialogs.import-theme-app-too-old: This theme needs AW Next {version} or newer.
dialogs.import-theme-format-too-new: This theme file was made by a newer version of AW Next.
dialogs.import-theme-invalid: This file is not a valid theme package.
dialogs.export-theme-css-unsupported: A stylesheet theme cannot be exported. Share the .css file itself instead.
dialogs.delete-theme-detail: The theme and the images it came with are removed from disk. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.delete-sound-detail: The imported sound file is removed from disk. This cannot be undone.
dialogs.theme-preview-replaces: A theme of this name is already installed.
dialogs.theme-preview-note: Nothing is installed until you confirm.
dialogs.could-not-move-the-folder-to-the-recycle: Could not move the folder to the Recycle Bin.
dialogs.steam-appid-to-pull-cover-art-from: Steam AppID to pull cover art from:
dialogs.no-steam-cover-art-for-appid: No Steam cover art found for AppID {appid}.
dialogs.no-ach-unconfigured: This folder does not have a Goldberg/GBE setup with a reliable Steam AppID yet.
dialogs.no-ach-no-schema: AW can show the game, but Steam did not provide an achievement schema for this AppID.
dialogs.no-detected-game-with-a-known-install-fo: No detected game with a known install folder to fix.
dialogs.apply-the-emulator-fix-to-x-detected-gam: Apply the emulator fix to {count} detected game(s)? Existing files are backed up before being overwritten.
dialogs.up-to-date: You are already using the latest version ({version}).
dialogs.update-ready-message: A new version ({version}) has been downloaded.
dialogs.update-ready-detail: Would you like to install it now?
dialogs.select-a-game-library-folder-to-scan: Select a game-library folder to scan
dialogs.scan-no-gbe-installs: No Goldberg / GBE Fork installs found in that folder.
dialogs.scan-found-count: Found {found} install(s); {missing} missing their achievements.json schema.
dialogs.emu-login-missing: Enter the Steam username and password first.
dialogs.emu-login-running: Connecting to Steam… Enter the Steam Guard code if requested.
dialogs.emu-login-success: Steam login successful. The generate_emu_config refresh token was saved.
dialogs.epic-desc: Optional. Connecting shows which achievements you have already unlocked in installed Epic games; names, descriptions and rarity work without it. Your token is stored encrypted on this PC.
dialogs.xbox-desc: Optional. Imports your Xbox PC library (Game Pass and Microsoft Store): achievements, unlock state and rarity come from Xbox Network and are cached locally. Your session token is stored encrypted on this PC.
dialogs.theme-layer-header-hint: The thin bar at the very top
dialogs.theme-layer-panel-hint: The big panel with the game list
dialogs.theme-layer-settings-hint: The window you are reading now
dialogs.rescan-selected-help: Choose only the saved-data or library folders that need a retry. Use Refresh to check every source.
dialogs.generate-configs-detail-auto-fix: This starts a full scan now. During that scan, AW Next applies the GBE/Goldberg auto-fix to detected games with a known install folder. Repairs run in the background: scan again if a freshly fixed game does not show as ready yet.
dialogs.generate-configs-detail-scan-only: This only starts a full detection scan. Automatic repair is disabled in Emulator configuration > Automatically fix newly detected games.
dialogs.x-emulated-game-s-found-in-your-librarie: {found} Steam-compatible install(s) found - {missing} have no existing fix and are eligible.
dialogs.scan-started-auto-fix: Scan started - {count} eligible unconfigured game(s) will receive an initial GBE config.
dialogs.scan-started-scan-only: Scan started - automatic repair is disabled, no files will be changed.
dialogs.error-while-trying-to-reset-user-blackli: Error while trying to reset user blacklist
dialogs.error-in-connection-establishment-net-er:
Error in connection establishment: net::ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED
Is Watchdog Running ?
dialogs.artwork-fetch-failed: Could not fetch artwork. Check your connection.
dialogs.cover-picker-fetch-failed: Could not fetch alternative covers. Check your connection and retry.
dialogs.update-ready-after-game: Version {version} is ready and will be installed once the running game is closed.
dialogs.diagnosis-icons-unavailable: Steam has no achievement artwork for this game yet, so no icon could be downloaded. The achievement list itself is complete; run the repair again once the artwork is published.
dialogs.diagnosis-dlls-backed-up-locations: Existing dll(s) backed up as *.bak in {count} location(s)
dialogs.diagnosis-auto-repaired-steam-settings: Auto-repaired steam_settings (schema + icons + DLCs) in {count} location(s)
dialogs.update-retry-failed-message: The update still failed after clearing the cached files in {folder}.
dialogs.update-retry-failed-detail: This is likely a network or release problem, not something clearing the cache can fix. You can download and install the update manually from the release page.
dialogs.clear-update-cache-confirm: Delete every re-downloadable cache (update files, Steam/Ubisoft schema & icon cache, downloaded emulator-fix tools)? Your settings, saves, backups and manually placed files are never touched - everything cleared here is simply re-fetched or re-downloaded automatically when needed.
dialogs.clear-update-cache-failed: Could not clear the update cache.
dialogs.clear-update-cache-empty: Nothing to clear - no cached update files found.
dialogs.clear-update-cache-done-all: Cleared {count} cache folder(s), including the update cache in {folder}.
dialogs.gh-value-missing-entries: {missing} of {total} missing from the emulator file
dialogs.gh-value-icons-unavailable: icons not published by Steam yet
dialogs.gh-verified-hint: Open the setting that rechecks achievement lists
dialogs.gh-action-failed: That repair could not be completed.
dialogs.gh-why-ready: This game is detected, its achievement data is available, and AW Next is watching it for unlocks.
dialogs.gh-why-attention: This game works, but part of its setup is incomplete. The checks below show which part.
dialogs.gh-why-not-installed: This game isn’t installed on this PC, or AW Next can’t tell where it is. Choose its executable so it can be watched.
dialogs.gh-why-install-gone: The game folder AW Next knew about is gone - it was moved, uninstalled, or is on a drive that is not connected. Point AW Next at the game again.
dialogs.gh-why-no-achievement-data: No achievement list could be found for this game, so there is nothing to track yet. Games with no achievements at all are normal here.
dialogs.gh-why-emulator-missing: This game needs a Steam emulator to record achievements, and none is set up in its folder. Use the emulator fix from the game’s right-click menu to set one up.
dialogs.gh-why-emulator-runtime-missing: The achievement data is in place, but the emulator file that reads it is missing from the game folder, so nothing will ever be recorded. AW Next can put it back.
dialogs.gh-why-uplay-broken: The Ubisoft emulator setup for this game is incomplete, so unlocks are not being recorded. Use the Uplay R2 repair button below.
dialogs.gh-why-achievement-data-incomplete: The achievement list AW Next has for this game doesn’t match what the game will look for, so some unlocks would be missed. This can be rewritten from the official data.
dialogs.gh-why-no-progress-yet: The game is detected and achievement data is available, but no achievement progress has been found yet. The likely issue is the game or emulator configuration rather than notifications.
dialogs.gh-why-install-unknown: AW Next is reading this game’s achievements from its save files, but doesn’t know where the game itself is installed. Locate it to enable playtime tracking and repairs.
dialogs.gh-why-notification-failed: This game is tracked correctly and its unlocks are being seen, but the last notification could not be sent. Send a test notification to check the display path.
dialogs.reset-ach-failed: The achievements could not be reset.
dialogs.reset-ach-official: This game’s achievements are stored by its platform, not on this PC.
dialogs.reset-ach-official-detail: Steam, GOG Galaxy, Ubisoft Connect, EA, Epic and Xbox keep unlocks on your account and re-synchronise them. Only the account itself can clear them.
dialogs.reset-ach-nothing: There is nothing to reset for this game yet.
dialogs.reset-ach-nothing-detail: AW Next has not recorded any unlock for it, and found no achievement save to clear.
dialogs.reset-ach-detail-count: {count} achievement file(s) will be backed up, then cleared:
dialogs.reset-ach-detail-manual: Manual unlocks for this game will also be cleared ({count}).
dialogs.reset-ach-detail-blocked: Unlocks held by {sources} cannot be reset from here and are left untouched.
dialogs.reset-ach-confirm-message: Every achievement of {game} goes back to locked, so the game can unlock them again.
dialogs.reset-ach-done-message: {count} file(s) cleared. Unlock them again in game and they will be announced as new.
dialogs.reset-ach-restore-message: The {count} file(s) saved on {date} go back to their original location, replacing what is there now.
dialogs.reset-ach-restore-rescan: Refresh the library to read the restored unlocks back in.
dialogs.reapply-gbe-message: This game already has a setup ({name}). Re-applying replaces it with a freshly generated one.
dialogs.reapply-gbe-detail: The current files are backed up first and can be restored from this same menu.
dialogs.gh-why-appid-mismatch: The emulator in this game’s folder announces game ID {appidOnDisk}, but AW Next matched this game to {appidExpected}. Achievements unlocked under the wrong ID are recorded against another game. Correct the file if {appidExpected} is the right game - the current value is kept.
dialogs.gh-appid-confirm-message: steam_appid.txt will be changed from {appidOnDisk} to {appidExpected}.
dialogs.gh-appid-confirm-detail: Only do this if {game} really is game {appidExpected} on Steam. If the emulator was set up on purpose for {appidOnDisk}, cancel: the file is right and the library card is what needs correcting. The current file is backed up under steam_settings\.aw-backups.
dialogs.gh-simple-notifications-failed: The last notification could not be sent
dialogs.gh-why-not-watched: Everything needed is in place, but AW Next isn’t watching this game while it runs, so playtime and live unlock notifications won’t happen.
dialogs.gh-why-progress-muted: This game is set up correctly. Progress notifications are muted for it, so only full unlocks will be announced.
dialogs.gh-why-nothing-unlocked-yet: This game is set up correctly and AW Next is watching it. Nothing has been unlocked yet, which is simply a game you haven’t made progress in.
dialogs.gh-confirm-repair-message: AW Next will write the achievement list, icons and emulator settings for this game.
dialogs.gh-confirm-runtime-message: AW Next will download the supported emulator build and install it into the game folder.
dialogs.interface-mode-hint-advanced: Showing everything AW Next can do.
dialogs.launch-needs-admin: Windows refused to start this game without administrator rights.
dialogs.launch-needs-admin-detail: Retry as administrator? Windows will ask you to confirm. AW Next itself stays unelevated - only the game is started with administrator rights.
dialogs.icon-picker-fetch-failed: Could not fetch alternative icons. Check your connection and retry.
dialogs.steam-install-message: This Steam game is not installed on this PC. Install it through Steam?
dialogs.steam-desc: Optional. Connect your Steam account so AW Next knows which games are really in your library today, including Steam Family shared games, and can hide the ones you no longer own. It also reads your unlocked Steam achievements when your profile is private. Your Steam password is never seen by AW Next: the sign-in page is Valve’s own. The session token is stored encrypted on this PC.
dialogs.steam-stale-badge: No longer in your Steam library
dialogs.steam-family-badge: Shared with you through Steam Family
dialogs.steam-hide-stale: Hide games no longer in your Steam library
dialogs.steam-hide-stale-help: Requires a connected Steam account. Games installed on this PC and games shared through Steam Family are never hidden.

watchdog.testDescription: This is a test notification from AW Next.
